content:
Implemented and committed `partial_structure` and `PartialResult` on branch `partial-structure` in commit `31acc7d`.

Focused checks passed for nested refinement, collection failures, attrs classes, dataclasses, TypedDicts, and both validation modes. The converter regression suite passed: **61 tests**.

The full test suite was not completed: collection was blocked by missing optional dependencies (`msgspec`, `yaml`, `immutables`, and `bson`), and the broader filtered run was still in progress at the last check. Ruff was not installed, so lint and formatting checks were not run.
